purpose: Candidate deterministic qualifier semantics for controlled logical time, applicability, replay/sequence handling, contradiction state, and feature independence.

context_gate.expected_scenario_id_source: frozen scenario registry derived from final manifest
context_gate.scenario_id_mapping: PROPOSED__opaque u32 ordinal/registry ID; final mapping not frozen
context_gate.wrong_scenario_behavior: drop as non-applicable; do not update path state; if no applicable evidence exists, path snapshot is absent/all-zero

required: mandatory fixed-width IDs/timestamps parseable and nonzero where required
structural_completeness.malformed_behavior: no applicable evidence snapshot update; absent/all-zero if no other applicable evidence exists

feature_derivation.signature_valid: 1 only when key_id resolves in the test public-key registry for the path/role and Ed25519 verification succeeds over exact 64-byte body; otherwise 0
feature_derivation.source_trusted: registry lookup of signed opaque source_id for producer role; independent of signature_valid
feature_derivation.fresh: controlled-time rule applied to parsed issued_logical_time; independent of signature_valid
feature_derivation.epoch_valid: signed evidence_epoch equals expected_epoch; independent of signature_valid
feature_derivation.authorization: if complete=1 preserve parsed signed authorization_value even when signature_valid=0; otherwise 0
feature_derivation.noncontradictory: path-local sequence/equivocation state; independent from cross-path disagreement

sequence_and_replay.baseline_updates_only_from: structurally complete, applicable, cryptographically valid evidence
sequence_and_replay.equal_sequence_different_body: sticky path contradiction; noncontradictory=0; do not silently choose consistency
sequence_and_replay.lower_sequence: sequence rollback/replay inconsistency; noncontradictory=0; do not roll baseline backward
sequence_and_replay.invalid_signature_sequence_effect: does not advance authenticated sequence baseline

invalid_signature_snapshot.noncontradictory: reflect current path-local contradiction state; invalid signature itself does not advance sequence baseline

unresolved_before_freeze: whether lower-sequence replay should also emit a separate audit reason code
exact qualifier implementation/state persistence boundary across cFS processes
